displayOrder.prompt:
Create a realistic production-quality UI design for the native SwiftUI Potato iPhone app's Remote control home screen. Use case: ui-mockup. Target logical dimensions 390 x 844 portrait; app content only, no phone bezel, device body, notch, Dynamic Island, OS status bar, clock, battery, home indicator, browser chrome, rounded device mask, shadow or external presentation titles. One screen only, never multiple panels or concepts side by side. Current date anchor 2026-09-12; no need to print a date. References 1 and 2 are the user's ChatGPT Remote/sidebar screenshots: borrow navigation logic and effortless list readability, don't reproduce their private chat names. Reference 3 is actual Potato native UI: preserve its warm white canvas #F8F7F4, charcoal ink #20211F, light warm gray fills, native SF Pro/PingFang Chinese system typography, fine SF Symbols style icons, ample whitespace and compact rounded bottom input. References 4 and 5 are Claude device chooser and Happy task review UI, use only interaction ideas. Use a restrained green online dot and muted amber attention indicator, no saturated gradients or illustrations. Body 15-17pt, titles 22-28pt, touch targets minimum 44pt. Use spacing and typography first, simple dividers second, avoid separate cards for every row and cards inside cards. Crisp legible Chinese labels, clean alignment, purposeful space. Focus on remote tasks running on the user's own computer; show a concrete task and its next action. No marketing copy, no backend implementation terms, no unsupported desktop video streaming. Make one clear primary action and no more than two supporting content areas; remaining app features exist off screen. The entire page must fit naturally without clipped labels or overlapping controls.
Direction name: 随身项目. The selected main navigation is Remote, accessed with a hamburger at top-left. Top centered title 远程, small plus at top-right. Below it a horizontal chip row 全部 selected black, green-dot laptop chip MacBook Pro, then a partially visible Mac mini chip suggesting horizontal scroll. Main emphasis is a calm flat project-and-session list, close to the user's ChatGPT reference. Near top one discreet warm-tinted attention strip: 需要你处理 · 1 with a single task 修复 iPhone 连接问题 and secondary text 等待批准运行测试, chevron on right. Then section heading 置顶, one plain row 手机远程控制. Then section 项目 with 3 airy folder rows Potato, WPAI, dynamo, small compose glyphs aligned right, lightweight gray labels under Potato: 2 个任务正在运行. Bottom a compact recent session row under 最近: 整理今日工作记录, secondary MacBook Pro · 已完成. A fixed bottom translucent warm-white dock with a long search pill 搜索远程会话, a black circular new task icon with ample breathing room. No additional feature tabs. Hierarchy should feel native, understated, easy to scan, with 20pt side margins.

Direction name: 待办优先. This is the Remote home screen organized around things the user needs to review now. Top left hamburger; small centered 远程 title, top-right subtle laptop device chooser. Below an understated device line green-dot MacBook Pro · 在线, change chevron. Main hero heading 需要你看一下 with small line 电脑在继续，有一件事等你决定. Primary content is one spacious task review region on the base white surface, task title 修复 iPhone 连接问题, small Potato · 等待确认, two-line summary 已完成连接恢复逻辑，准备运行项目测试。, an inset minimal monospace command line cargo test, footer one prominent black 查看并确认 button (this opens details, does not execute). This is a single standalone attention object so one soft boundary is permitted. Below a thin divider and section 正在电脑上进行, two normal rows: 整理项目文档 with gray subtitle WPAI · 正在整理文件, and 排查推理服务日志 with subtitle dynamo · 正在读取日志. Add a small textual 查看全部任务 link. Bottom native tab-style navigation with four subtle icons and labels 对话, 远程 (active charcoal), 文稿, 设置. Floating just above the bottom nav a black pill with compose icon 新建远程任务 aligned trailing, not a giant full-width CTA. Keep 22pt margins, crisp editorial hierarchy, almost no chrome. No extra metrics, gradients, marketing headings, screen-streaming or inaccessible terminal emulation.

Direction name: 电脑工作台. Make the remote home host-centered with one selected computer and its project. Header hamburger left, centered Potato in 22pt semibold with small subtitle 远程 beneath, right ellipsis. Below, two horizontal device tiles using one shared light-gray rounded strip rather than many cards: MacBook Pro with green dot 在线 active, Mac mini with gray dot 离线 inactive. Then generous spacing and a single project breadcrumb folder Potato with trailing downward chevron; secondary 连接到 MacBook Pro. Primary focus a large unboxed heading 继续上次的工作. Show task 手机远程控制 in medium headline, one-line description 正在完善配对与连接恢复, small status amber dot 有一项操作需要确认. An inline single outlined 查看待确认操作 row with arrow is the primary task action; do NOT show immediate blind approve. Then a section 项目中的其他任务 with two flat rows 整理安装与使用说明 and 检查 iPhone 输入体验, subtle timestamps 今天 and 昨天 (date anchor today 2026-09-12). One small footer row 文件与改动 with document symbol and +18 −6 subdued green/red as illustrative diff summary. Bottom fixed native Potato composer: rounded white input with placeholder 让这台电脑做点什么…; compact second row plus icon on left, gray project chip Potato with down chevron, mic icon and circular black arrow-up send right. This composer is the prominent way to start new work on this selected host. No bottom tab bar; navigation stays in hamburger. Warm white single surface, no hero illustration, no desktop screenshot, no heavy card stack. Leave enough breathing room so it looks sophisticated and calm, recognizable as existing Potato but designed for remote continuity.
